propositions: Historical Rebar structured-output behavior including deterministic repair, schema extraction, three-attempt ceiling, stop-reason fast-fail, provider-aware output modes, and durable usage/telemetry must be preserved or explicitly changed by maintainer decision only, never silently inherited from Pydantic AI 1.107.2 implementation.

The offline integration probe must exercise real Pydantic Agent/output/retry/UsageLimits/FallbackModel/event-stream seams without live model calls, verify exact call counts and usage fields, and record all observable deltas against current Rebar test evidence.

Complete failed responses on output retry must send whole output only when deterministic fit is proven via count_tokens; otherwise omit the entire failed response from retry context while preserving it in stored history and accepted/final-failure artifacts.

Successful output retries must report aggregate operation usage (requests and tokens consumed across all attempts) in the single operation row, telemetry, and JSONL, not accepted-attempt-only projection.
Output-size and partial-JSON exhaustion must re-raise only the exact Rebar-owned cause-chain StructuredOutputError, never blanket-translate upstream UnexpectedModelBehavior.
